text: I think you might be surprised by this recommendation, but hear me out. While the title suggests it's not vegetarian-friendly, the ingredients don't actually include any meat. The marinade ingredients are all plant-based, and the soy sauce is a key component, which I know you tend to like. The recipe is also quick to make and has a relatively low saturated fat content, which aligns with your past preferences. Give it a try and see how you like it!
